hardware: No MFMA/WMMA matrix instructions; cannot be added in software
SDMA disabled; experimental VM heap disabled (safe defaults)
~16 GB VRAM per board, shared CPU/GPU memory; a single all-resident 1B FSDP state floor exceeds physical RAM
Advanced hardware profiling (PC sampling/RDC) unqualified; attained-clock/temperature/power telemetry semantics unvalidated; gpu_busy_percent returns EOPNOTSUPP
software_subsets: Scalar backends have documented API/type/operator subsets
Model admission is per-architecture bounded evidence (causal LMs, owned UNet2D, RNN/LSTM/GRU); not a universal support claim; diffusers absent (UNet is owned pure-torch)
Production nonsymmetric eig uses host LAPACK; native ILU(0)/IC(0) sparse factorization + preconditioned solve exists (opt-in, machine precision); rocSPARSE has no general direct sparse LU/Cholesky
Math SDPA qualified; opt-in tiled/hybrid attention is performance-qualified with dropout/compile/graph boundaries

torch.compile coverage extends to attention/LoRA/embed+CE/dynamic (correctness, not throughput); HIP graph capture of a training step is bitwise-exact (opt-in, static shapes, dropout=0); TRL fused linear-CE boolean indexing is not graph-safe
W8 and native NF4/QLoRA quantization exist (NF4 opt-in: memory win, not compute win, on RDNA1); packed INT4 hardware-blocked (no MFMA); TorchAO/bitsandbytes not installed
Qualified training policies include FP32/BF16 and FP16 PEFT (incl. distributed FSDP FP16 PEFT with activation checkpointing and exact restart); broader recipes/larger models separate
performance: No general two-board speedup claim; two-board FSDP can be far slower than single-board when the model fits; two boards buy capacity and redundancy, not a linear speedup
Per-operation speed frontier exhausted: the GEMM term is structural and native fused non-GEMM levers are near-optimal; further step-time reduction needs a model/algorithm-level approach
Measured wall times are admission costs, not performance guarantees
release_boundaries: Release is immutable; torch remains an editable install from the materialized tree
Rebuilt binaries are reconstruction proof, not the shipped artifact; the release ships the qualified deployed cohort
Triton provenance is pin+patches+qualified wheel; no Triton rebuild demonstration (accepted scope decision)
Stability qualified by a bounded multi-segment soak (exact resume at stock clocks); indefinite long-run behavior and unknown Python/KFD/clocksource causes remain separate
Qualification uses owned fixtures only; user applications are excluded
deployment: Boot fallbacks and rollback assets preserved (historical cohorts + retained base + boot-health package)
Run the board at stock clocks (<=2000 MHz); a persistent SMU overclock destabilizes the GPU under sustained load
superseded_runtime_limitation: The runtime.json limitations string "Mutable developer prefix" describes the dev cohort; the release itself is immutable. Editable Torch remains.
